about_pfm.label: Who We Are
about_pfm.title: A Voice for Palestine in Malaysia
about_pfm.body1: Palestinian Forum Malaysia (PFM) was established to unite the Palestinian community and their supporters across Malaysia. We work tirelessly to build community bonds, advocate for justice, and deliver humanitarian aid.
about_pfm.body2: Through events, campaigns, and grassroots organizing, we ensure the Palestinian cause is heard, felt, and acted upon — right here in Malaysia.

footer.tagline: Uniting Palestinians and supporters across Malaysia through community, advocacy, and humanitarian action.

contact.title: Contact Us
contact.subtitle: We'd love to hear from you — reach out anytime.
contact.description: Have a question, want to volunteer, or need help with a donation? Our team is here for you. Reach out through any of the channels below.
contact.subject: Subject
contact.success_body: Thank you for reaching out. Our team will get back to you within 24–48 hours.

donate.hero_subtitle: Every contribution helps us deliver aid, support education, and stand with the Palestinian community in Malaysia.
donate.placeholder_notice: The details below are sample placeholders and will be updated with our real donation information soon.
donate.qr_desc: Open your banking or e-wallet app and scan the QR code below to donate directly.
donate.bank_desc: Prefer a manual transfer? Use the account details below.
donate.faq_a1: Yes. All transfers go directly through your own bank or e-wallet app — we never ask for your card details or banking passwords.
donate.faq_q2: Will I receive a receipt for my donation?
donate.faq_a2: Yes, email us your transfer confirmation and we'll send you an official receipt.
donate.faq_a3: This depends on your country of residence. Contact us and we'll let you know what documentation we can provide.
donate.faq_q4: Can I set up a recurring monthly donation?
donate.faq_a4: Yes, simply repeat the bank transfer each month, or contact us and we can help set up a standing instruction with your bank.
donate.faq_q5: Who can I contact if I have questions about my donation?
donate.faq_a5: Reach out to us on the Contact page — our team typically responds within 24–48 hours.

home.pillar_community_desc: Connecting Palestinians and supporters across Malaysia through shared values and solidarity.
home.pillar_advocacy_desc: Raising awareness, championing justice, and amplifying the Palestinian voice in Malaysia.
home.pillar_humanitarian_desc: Coordinating donations, relief efforts, and on-ground support for those who need it most.

about.hero_subtitle: Who we are, what we believe, and why we exist.
about.story_body1: Palestinian Forum Malaysia was founded by Palestinians and Malaysian supporters who needed an organized, credible voice for Palestine in Malaysia.
about.story_body2: What started as informal gatherings has grown into a structured organization running campaigns, hosting events, and channelling aid directly to Palestinians in need.
about.mission_body: To unite Palestinians and supporters in Malaysia, advocate for Palestinian rights, deliver humanitarian aid, and raise awareness through community action.
about.vision_body: A free, just Palestine — and a Malaysian community that stands proudly with the Palestinian people, informed, organized, and ready to act with compassion and strength.
about.value_justice_desc: We believe every human life has equal worth. Justice for Palestine is justice for all.
about.value_solidarity_desc: We stand together — Malaysian, Palestinian, and all who believe in a just world.
about.value_transparency_desc: Every donation is accounted for. We publish reports so you know where your help goes.
about.value_action_desc: We don't just raise awareness — we mobilize, fundraise, and act when it matters most.
about.obj1_desc: Create a strong, connected network of Palestinians and supporters across all Malaysian states.
about.obj2_desc: Raise the Palestinian cause in Malaysian public, political, and academic spheres.
about.obj3_desc: Coordinate and dispatch medical, food, and financial aid to Palestinians in need.
about.obj4_desc: Fund scholarships and mentorship programmes for Palestinian students in Malaysia.
about.obj5_desc: Build alliances with Malaysian NGOs, institutions, and international organisations.
about.obj6_desc: Develop the next generation of Palestinian-Malaysian advocates and community leaders.
about.coverage_desc: PFM has an active presence in major cities across Malaysia, bringing the community together nationwide.
about.partners_desc: We work alongside trusted organisations to maximise our impact for the Palestinian community.
about.reports_desc: We believe in full transparency. Download our annual reports and see exactly how your support makes a difference.
about.cta_desc: Whether you donate, volunteer, or simply spread the word — every action strengthens our community and amplifies the Palestinian cause.
